channel.title: Klaviyo - What's New
channel.description: Latest Klaviyo product updates and releases (unofficial feed).

item.title: Downloadable files from Composer artifacts
item.description:
Downloadable files from Composer artifacts — Bring reports and slides to your next meeting â Ask Composer for a dashboard PDF, site or a downloadable PowerPoint deck.
(Published 2026-11-03)

item.title: Manage Email Tracking Consent on Preference Pages

(Published 2026-11-03)

item.title: Shopify edits in Composer
item.description:
Shopify edits in Composer — Update your store without leaving Klaviyo â Ask Composer to make changes in Shopify, from prices to discount codes.
(Published 2026-11-02)

item.title: Composer now connects with Asana
item.description:
Composer now connects with Asana — Go from brief to campaign without copying anything over â Connect Asana and Composer turns your briefs and calendar into Klaviyo campaigns and flows.
(Published 2026-11-02)

item.title: Source Attribution in Customer Agent
item.description:
Source Attribution in Customer Agent — Know which messages drive AI-assisted sales â View Customer Agent revenue by flow, campaign, and web chat conversation starter in Service Overview, then ask Composer to dig in.
(Published 2026-11-02)

item.title: Improved Auto-Reply Editor
item.description:
Improved Auto-Reply Editor — Capture richer data and more clicks from Instagram DMs â Preview conversations as you edit Social Auto-replies, collect date properties, and send links as buttons.
(Published 2026-11-02)

item.title: Send to Primary Device
item.description:
Send to Primary Device — Reduce push costs and repeat notifications â Send push messages only to each customer's most active device with a new toggle in campaign and flow builders.
(Published 2026-11-02)

item.title: Expanded Product Recommendations for Customer Agent
item.description:
Expanded Product Recommendations for Customer Agent — Help more shoppers find what to buy in chat â Use Customer Agent on WooCommerce and Magento 2 to recommend in-stock products with prices, images, and links.
(Published 2026-10-30)

item.title: Sync up to 6 objects with the SFDC integration
item.description:
Sync up to 6 objects with the SFDC integration — Bring more Salesforce data into Klaviyo â Sync up to 6 Salesforce objects instead of 3 to segment and personalize with fuller customer context.
(Published 2026-10-30)

item.title: Assignment Notification Emails in Helpdesk
item.description:
Assignment Notification Emails in Helpdesk — Catch new ticket assignments right away, even outside the helpdesk â Turn on assignment emails in Helpdesk settings to get notified each time a ticket is assigned to you.
(Published 2026-10-30)

item.title: Take action from a comment thread with Composer
item.description:
Take action from a comment thread with Composer — Turn feedback into edits faster. Send a comment thread from the email editor or forms designer to Composer, and it drafts the requested changes or summarizes the thread.
(Published 2026-10-29)

item.title: Simpler usage meter in Composer
item.description:
Simpler usage meter in Composer — One bar shows how much you've used and when it resets, with a warning at 85%. Billing usage reports now include Composer credits.
(Published 2026-10-29)

item.title: Private or shared skills in Composer
item.description:
Private or shared skills in Composer — When you create a skill, choose whether to keep it private or share it with your team.
(Published 2026-10-29)

item.title: Enhanced Capabilities - HTML Content Blocks
item.description:
Enhanced Capabilities - HTML Content Blocks — Design fully branded onsite content without template limits â Add custom HTML and CSS to content blocks for Customer Hub and your site, with real-time preview and unsupported-code warnings.
(Published 2026-10-29)

item.title: WhatsApp Channel Affinity
item.description:
WhatsApp Channel Affinity — Reach WhatsApp-first shoppers on the channel they prefer â Build segments using WhatsApp channel affinity rankings alongside email, SMS, and push predictions.
(Published 2026-10-29)

item.title: Floating Composer bar
item.description:
Floating Composer bar — Ask Composer from anywhere in Klaviyo. Its input box follows you from page to page, with prompts that fit where you are and keep open and hide controls.
(Published 2026-10-28)

item.title: Next-step suggestions in Composer
item.description:
Next-step suggestions in Composer — Keep the work moving. The message box cycles through the next steps Composer suggested in its latest reply, so you can pick one without retyping it.
(Published 2026-10-28)

item.title: Location Hub
item.description:
Location Hub — Reach customers near every location in a few clicks â Add stores and live events to build proximity segments and track in-store revenue with Shopify POS.
(Published 2026-10-28)

item.title: Artifacts in Composer
item.description:
Artifacts in Composer — Anything Composer makes can become an artifact: a live web page with its own link, built from a single ask.
(Published 2026-10-28)

item.title: Spam to Intake Rules in Helpdesk
item.description:
Spam to Intake Rules in Helpdesk — Decide what counts as spam in your support queue â Create a custom intake rule when you mark a message as spam so Helpdesk sorts similar future messages correctly.
(Published 2026-10-28)

item.title: Live Product Experts in Composer
item.description:
Live Product Experts in Composer — Get answers and live help without repeating yourself â Click Support to ask Composer, then connect with a Product Expert in the same chat with context carried over.
(Published 2026-10-28)

item.title: Smart Translations for Consent Pages
item.description:
Smart Translations for Consent Pages — Give subscribers a localized experience from sign-up onward â Translate hosted subscribe, unsubscribe, and preferences pages plus double opt-in emails into multiple languages with Smart Translations.
(Published 2026-10-28)

item.title: Export campaign analytics
item.description:
Export campaign analytics — Compare campaign results across email, SMS, push, and WhatsApp in one file â Export a CSV filtered by date, tag, channel, and A/B variation.
(Published 2026-10-27)

item.title: In-App Forms API
item.description:
In-App Forms API — Automate mobile form creation with code or AI agents â Create In-App Forms and retrieve them by ID with channel details through the Klaviyo API, just like web forms.
(Published 2026-10-27)

item.title: Explain this segment in Composer
item.description:
Explain this segment in Composer — Understand any segment at a glance. Hover over a segment in Lists & segments and pick Explain this segment to see what itâs for.
(Published 2026-10-26)

item.title: Approval cards in Composer
item.description:
Approval cards in Composer — Know exactly what will change before you approve it. Campaign sends and schedules, coupon changes and custom object changes now come with a card that shows the details first.
(Published 2026-10-26)

item.title: Rewrite with Composer
item.description:
Rewrite with Composer — Polish your copy without leaving the editor. In the drag and drop email editor, rewrite any text block with Composer and apply the new version in one click.
(Published 2026-10-26)

item.title: Add to Composer from Campaigns
item.description:
Add to Composer from Campaigns — Campaigns and flows in your lists have an Add to Composer button that drops them into the chat for reference.
(Published 2026-10-23)

item.title: Clone Suggestions in Composer
item.description:
Clone Suggestions in Composer — Cloning a campaign suggests how Composer could adapt it, like adding missing preview text or making a text message version.
(Published 2026-10-23)

item.title: Support now opens Composer
item.description:
Support now opens Composer — Get help with more room to work. Clicking Support in the header, sidebar or mobile menu now opens a full page Composer chat instead of the old Support window.
(Published 2026-10-23)

item.title: Fix flows with Composer
item.description:
Fix flows with Composer — Go from alert to fix faster. Click Fix with Composer on any flow alert to hand the flowâs problems straight to Composer.
(Published 2026-10-23)

item.title: Attach more file types in Composer
item.description:
Attach more file types in Composer — You can now share more than images. Attach other file types to a Composer chat, and youâll see which files Composer read and which types it couldnât use.
(Published 2026-10-23)

item.title: Historical Consent Sync from Wix
item.description:
Historical Consent Sync from Wix — Migrate from Wix with email consent intact â Import subscription status automatically during your initial sync, with newer consent always winning and no manual CSV upload.
(Published 2026-10-23)

item.title: Version history for email templates
item.description:
Version history for email templates — Undo bad template edits without rebuilding from scratch â Preview any saved version of a drag-and-drop email template and restore it, with your current version saved first.
(Published 2026-10-23)

item.title: Create a segment from the segment drawer with Composer
item.description:
Create a segment from the segment drawer with Composer — Start a segment with Composer from the Create segment drawer in Lists & segments.
(Published 2026-10-22)

item.title: Brand Styles in Forms
item.description:
Brand Styles in Forms — Launch on-brand forms in a few clicks â Set form defaults once, then apply your brand's buttons, text, input fields, and colors to every new form.
(Published 2026-10-22)

item.title: @mention campaigns and flows in Composer
item.description:
@mention campaigns and flows in Composer — Point Composer at exactly the right work. Type @ to find a campaign or flow by name, so Composer works on the one you picked.
(Published 2026-10-21)

item.title: Probabilistic Matching
item.description:
Probabilistic Matching — Keep segments and reporting accurate with cleaner profiles â Merge likely duplicates in Klaviyo based on shared emails, phone numbers, and similar names, with no exports or custom code.
(Published 2026-10-21)

item.title: Signatures for Outbound Email Replies in Helpdesk
item.description:
Signatures for Outbound Email Replies in Helpdesk — Send polished, consistent support replies without the copy-paste â Set a custom signature with agent name, company name, and logo that's added to every outbound email reply in Helpdesk.
(Published 2026-10-20)

item.title: Copy a campaign in Composer
item.description:
Copy a campaign in Composer — Build on campaigns that already work. Ask Composer to copy a saved campaign and change it, then preview the copy before Composer creates it with your approval.
(Published 2026-10-19)

item.title: SQL and results behind answer in Composer
item.description:
SQL and results behind answer in Composer — For analytics answers, read the SQL Composer ran and see the rows it got back on a Results tab.
(Published 2026-10-19)

item.title: Skills as cards in Composer
item.description:
Skills as cards in Composer — Each skill shows a preview of its contents, with search and a list view.
(Published 2026-10-19)

item.title: Performance Improvements in Customer Agent
item.description:
Performance Improvements in Customer Agent — Answer shoppers faster and more reliably with AI â Resolve complex questions with upgraded knowledge retrieval that speeds up every Customer Agent response and cuts failed replies.
(Published 2026-10-19)

item.title: Onsite Previews in Forms
item.description:
Onsite Previews in Forms — See your form before going live â Preview drafts on any page of your site, scan a QR code to test on mobile, and see saved edits refresh automatically.
(Published 2026-10-19)

item.title: Set audiences per message in Composer
item.description:
Set audiences per message in Composer — Composer can set who gets each message in a campaign, remove a message or audience, and copy a message to another audience, all shown in the preview for approval.
(Published 2026-10-16)

item.title: Klaviyo now available in Japanese
item.description:
Klaviyo now available in Japanese — Work in Klaviyo in your team's native language â Use the Klaviyo app and Help Center in Japanese to build, send, and find answers without translating.
(Published 2026-10-16)

item.title: Build Customer Agent with Composer
item.description:
Build Customer Agent with Composer — Build, test, and operate Customer Agent right inside Composer, the same interface you already use for marketing, so one workspace now powers both your campaigns and your customer conversations.
(Published 2026-10-16)

item.title: SLA policies in Helpdesk
item.description:
SLA policies in Helpdesk — Keep every support promise you make to customers â Set first response, second response targets, and resolution targets in Helpdesk and see live countdowns on each ticket before deadlines slip.
(Published 2026-10-15)

item.title: Multi-Geo in
item.description:
Multi-Geo in — Give every shopper the right policies, products, and prices for their country â Customer Agent knowledge and skills is now focused to chosen regions or Shopify markets with one agent.
(Published 2026-10-15)

item.title: SMS and WhatsApp Consent Block on Shopify
item.description:
SMS and WhatsApp Consent Block on Shopify — Grow SMS and WhatsApp subscribers with a consent block that fits your checkout â Collect sign-ups with one checkbox and set header style and borders to match Shopify checkout.
(Published 2026-10-15)

item.title: Customer Hub Content Blocks in Flows
item.description:
Customer Hub Content Blocks in Flows — Carry flow messages onto your website â Add a Customer Hub block action to any flow to show content in each shopper's For You tab.
(Published 2026-10-15)

item.title: Visibility Testing in Customer Hub
item.description:
Visibility Testing in Customer Hub — Prove impact before rolling out to every shopper â Show Customer Hub to a chosen share of visitors for a set time and track engagement and revenue.
(Published 2026-10-15)

item.title: Prompt ideas for connectors in Composer
item.description:
Prompt ideas for connectors in Composer — Each connector suggests ideas, like promoting your Shopify best sellers, that start a chat in one click. The + button and @ now open the same menu.
(Published 2026-10-14)

item.title: Collect Email Tracking Consent in Sign-Up Forms
item.description:
Collect Email Tracking Consent in Sign-Up Forms — Keep measuring email engagement while staying compliant with EU privacy rules â Collect explicit marketing and email tracking consent from new subscribers in your sign-up forms.
(Published 2026-10-14)

item.title: Custom Object available on all accounts
item.description:
Custom Object available on all accounts — Custom Objects is now available to all Klaviyo accounts. You can build a real object, see how it works with their data, and decide how you want to use custom objects for your unique business use case.
(Published 2026-10-14)

item.title: Convert HTML email templates to drag and drop
item.description:
Convert HTML email templates to drag and drop — Edit any HTML template without touching code â Convert saved HTML email templates, including imported and AI-generated ones, into editable drag-and-drop templates in a few clicks.
(Published 2026-10-14)

item.title: BFCM Hub Composer Card
item.description:
BFCM Hub Composer Card — A ready-made BFCM prompt for your business starts a chat in one click.
(Published 2026-10-13)

item.title: The new Composer is live
item.description:
The new Composer is live — Composer, your AI marketing agent inside Klaviyo, just leveled up. It's now more intelligent, flexible, and proactive, helping you tackle more marketing jobs.
(Published 2026-10-13)

item.title: Owned Social Insights
item.description:
Owned Social Insights — See what drives Instagram engagement without digging through data â Review daily insights on your best formats, topics, and posting times in the social content library.
(Published 2026-10-08)

item.title: Social Performance

Social Performance — See which social content actually drives revenue â Track order-attributed revenue, engagement, top creators, and trends over time, then dig deeper with Composer.
(Published 2026-10-08)
